name: Honest reviews
text:
Highly recommended Delicious food with excellent taste and quality at a reasonable price. Definitely worth trying.

The 1,000 minimum order for delivery is too high. At least within the same town, smaller orders should also be delivered. Not everyone can spend 1,000 every time. Please reconsider this policy.
responseFromOwnerText: Thank you keep visiting and referring to friends and family..
